llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed CellCog integration that sends user-selected prompts and tagged files to an external AI service and downloads generated outputs.

dimensions.detail: External API use, API-key authentication, optional long-running notify mode, and generated-file downloads are proportionate to the stated sub-agent workflow but require user awareness.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is documentation-only, requires python3 and CELLCOG_API_KEY, and suggests installing the official cellcog SDK if needed; no bundled executable or hidden install script is present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The invocation description is very broad, but the artifact clearly explains that local file contents are only shared when paths are wrapped in SHOW_FILE tags and warns users not to attach secrets or credentials.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Notify mode uses a background WebSocket delivery mechanism and generated files may be downloaded to default or user-specified paths; these behaviors are disclosed and tied to task completion rather than hidden persistence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The broad multimodal sub-agent purpose matches the documented capabilities: research, media, documents, code, file inputs, and generated artifacts through CellCog.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to use CellCog as a third-party AI service. Treat SHOW_FILE like uploading an attachment: only tag files you are comfortable sending to CellCog, avoid secrets and private keys, and review generated output paths before asking it to create files.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] expected: The broad description is supported by the artifact's stated any-to-any CellCog purpose. It increases the need for user care around when the skill is invoked, but the file-upload behavior is explicitly disclosed and guarded by SHOW_FILE tagging guidance.
